name: Crispy Spring Rolls
desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. Shredded meat and vegetables are wrapped in a thin pancake, rolled into a tube, and then fried until golden. Crunchy on the outside, smooth on the inside, these little delicacies are cherished by old and young alike.

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 200 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
